name: 1-hexanol
aliases: 1-hexyl alcohol, 1-hydroxyhexane, amylcarbinol, caproic alcohol, capronyl alcohol, caproyl alcohol, hexyl alcohol, n-hexan-1-ol
summary: 1-Hexanol (IUPAC name hexan-1-ol) is an organic alcohol with a six-carbon chain and a condensed structural formula of CH3(CH2)5OH. This colorless liquid is slightly soluble in water, but miscible with diethyl ether and ethanol. Two additional straight chain isomers of 1-hexanol, 2-hexanol and 3-hexanol, exist, both of which differing by the location of the hydroxyl group.

uses.text: It is used in the perfume industry.

summaryZh: 1-己醇（英語：1-hexanol）也稱為正己醇，是一種醇類有機化合物，也是一種六碳醇，其化學式為C6H13OH，其示性式為CH35OH。
summaryZhHans: 1-己醇（英语：1-hexanol）也称为正己醇，是一种醇类有机化合物，也是一种六碳醇，其化学式为C6H13OH，其示性式为CH35OH。

pharmacology.en: Like other simple alcohols, it is thought to dampen brain activity, partly by acting on GABA-A receptors. Longer chain alcohols like this one are generally stronger than ethanol.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他簡單的醇類一樣，它被認為會抑制大腦活動，部分是透過作用於GABA-A受體。像它這樣碳鏈較長的醇類通常比乙醇作用更強。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他简单的醇类一样，它被认为会抑制大脑活动，部分是通过作用于GABA-A受体。像它这样碳链较长的醇类通常比乙醇作用更强。

sideEffects.en: It irritates the skin, eyes and throat. Swallowing it can cause nausea, headache, dizziness and drowsiness.
sideEffects.zh: 它會刺激皮膚、眼睛與喉嚨。吞下可能造成噁心、頭痛、頭暈與嗜睡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会刺激皮肤、眼睛与喉咙。吞下可能造成恶心、头痛、头晕与嗜睡。

fact.en: Its old name, caproic alcohol, comes from the Latin caper, meaning goat, because the related caproic acid smells like goats.
fact.zh: 它的舊名「羊油醇」（caproic alcohol）源自拉丁文caper，意思是山羊，因為相關的己酸聞起來有山羊的氣味。
fact.zhHans: 它的旧名「羊油醇」（caproic alcohol）源自拉丁文caper，意思是山羊，因为相关的己酸闻起来有山羊的气味。
